020import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
021import net.tnemc.core.TNECore;
022import net.tnemc.core.account.Account;
023import net.tnemc.core.transaction.Receipt;
024import net.tnemc.core.transaction.history.SortedHistory;
025import net.tnemc.menu.core.Menu;
026import net.tnemc.menu.core.Page;
027import net.tnemc.menu.core.builder.IconBuilder;
028import net.tnemc.menu.core.builder.PageBuilder;
029import net.tnemc.menu.core.callbacks.page.PageOpenCallback;
030import net.tnemc.menu.core.icon.Icon;
031import net.tnemc.menu.core.icon.action.impl.DataAction;
032import net.tnemc.menu.core.icon.action.impl.SwitchPageAction;

034import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.io.message.MessageData;
035import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.io.message.MessageHandler;
036
037import java.util.Collections;
038import java.util.LinkedList;
039import java.util.Optional;
040import java.util.UUID;
041
042/**
043 * TransactionMenu
044 *
045 * @author creatorfromhell
046 * @since 0.1.2.0
047 */
048public class TransactionMenu extends Menu {
049
050  public static final int TRANSACTION_VIEW = 2;
051  public static final String TRANSACTION_PAGE_ID = "TRANSACTION_HISTORY_PAGE";
052  public static final int TRANSACTION_HISTORY_COUNT = 10;
053
054  public TransactionMenu() {
055
056    this.name = "transaction_menu";
057    this.title = "Transactions";
058    this.rows = 4;
059
060    /*
061     * Main Page
062     */
063    final Page main = new PageBuilder(1).build();
064    main.setOpen(this::handleMainPage);
065    addPage(main);
066
067    final Page view = new PageBuilder(TRANSACTION_VIEW).build();
068    main.setOpen(this::handleMainPage);
069    addPage(view);
070  }
071
072  public void handleMainPage(final PageOpenCallback callback) {
073
074    final UUID id = callback.getPlayer().identifier();
075    final Optional<Account> account = TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(callback.getPlayer().identifier());
076    if(account.isEmpty()) {
077      return;
078    }
079
080    final SortedHistory sorted = account.get().getSorted(account.get().getIdentifier());
081    final int pagesPer = TRANSACTION_HISTORY_COUNT / 5;
082    final int pageDiv = sorted.maxPages() / pagesPer;
083    final int maxPages = sorted.maxPages() % pagesPer > 0? pageDiv + 1 : pageDiv;
084    final int page = callback.getPlayer().viewer().isPresent()
085                     ? (Integer)callback.getPlayer().viewer().get().dataOrDefault(TRANSACTION_PAGE_ID, 1) : 1;
086    addNavigation(callback, id, page, maxPages);
087    scanTransactions(account.get(), sorted, page);
088  }
089
090  private void addNavigation(final PageOpenCallback callback, final UUID id, final int page,
091                             final int maxPages) {
092
093    if(maxPages <= 1) {
094      return;
095    }
096    final int prev = page <= 1? maxPages : page - 1;
097    final int next = page >= maxPages? 1 : page + 1;
098    callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("RED_WOOL", 1)
099                                                       .customName(MessageHandler.grab(new MessageData("Messages.Menu.Shared.PreviousPageDisplay"), id))
100                                                       .lore(Collections.singletonList(MessageHandler.grab(new MessageData("Messages.Menu.Shared.PreviousPage"), id))))
101                                       .withActions(new DataAction(TRANSACTION_PAGE_ID, prev), new SwitchPageAction(this.name, 1))
102                                       .withSlot(0).build());
103    callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("GREEN_WOOL", 1)
104                                                       .customName(MessageHandler.grab(new MessageData("Messages.Menu.Shared.NextPageDisplay"), id))
105                                                       .lore(Collections.singletonList(MessageHandler.grab(new MessageData("Messages.Menu.Shared.NextPage"), id))))
106                                       .withActions(new DataAction(TRANSACTION_PAGE_ID, next), new SwitchPageAction(this.name, 1))
107                                       .withSlot(8).build());
108  }
109
110  private void scanTransactions(final Account account, final SortedHistory sorted, final int page) {
111
112    int slot = 9;
113    for(int i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
114      final int adjustedPage = i + page - 1;
115      if(adjustedPage > sorted.maxPages()) {
116        break;
117      }
118      for(final UUID id : sorted.getPage(adjustedPage)) {
119        final Optional<Receipt> receipt = account.findReceipt(id);
120        if(receipt.isPresent()) {
121          //callback.getPage().addIcon(buildTransactionIcon(slot, receipt.get()));
122        }
123      }
124      slot += 2;
125    }
126  }
127
128  protected Icon buildTransactionIcon(final int slot, final UUID transaction) {
129
130    final LinkedList<Component> lore = new LinkedList<>();
131    lore.add(Component.text("Click for information."));
132
133    return new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("PAPER", 1)
134                                   .customName(Component.text(transaction.toString())).lore(lore))
135            .withSlot(slot)
136            .withActions(new SwitchPageAction(this.name, TRANSACTION_VIEW)).build();
137  }
138}
